_doc: Setup standard for a new Smartlead inbox. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-13-inbox-intake-design.md. daily_rampup 0 = ramp off (Smartlead accepts 5-20). max_email_per_day = campaign emails only (Smartlead support 15 Oct). weekly_step / max_daily = ScaledMail volume rule (15 Oct): Google 15 +2/week max 20, Outlook (3/domain) 5 +1/week max 10 and ScaledMail Outlook (25/domain) 5 +1/week max 8 (Manveen, 15 Oct); SMTP 7 +1/week max 10 per inbox (ScaledMail, 15 Oct). good_reputation = warmup reputation counted healthy (ScaledMail: SMTP runs lower, fine above 70%); rotate_ip_below = ask ScaledMail to rotate the order IP.
